scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web,admin -c gray,blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend -w frontend -w admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w markdown -w backend -w frontend -w admin
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
